summary: List Recycled Action Plan Template Approvers
description: Returns all Recycled Action Plan Template Approvers for a given Project

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[plan_template_id]
parameters.description: Return section(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Template ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

schema.description: Recycled Project Action Plan Template Approvers (Index)

items.description: Recycled Project Action Plan Template Approver (Show)

id.description: Unique identifier of the deleted template approver.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the approver was moved to the recycle bin. ISO 8601 format.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the approver was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

first_name.description: First name of the Party Person

last_name.description: Last name of the Party Person

name.description: Full name of the Party Person

user_id.description: User ID of the login account associated with this party person.

is_employee.description: Whether this party person is an employee of the current company, as opposed to an external vendor contact.

employee_id.description: Employee ID string for this party person. Null if no employee ID is assigned.

login.description: Email address (login) of the party person's user account.

updated_at.description: Time the Party Person was updated
